title: 大慶油田
summary: 大慶是中國重要油田系統，包含成熟開發與新型資源研究；課程著重資料分區和含水處理帳。本課依序分析高含水情境的總液量、不同區塊的有效體積、產油與回收概念區分、處理水回用量帳、年代不同資料的對齊，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Daqing is a major Chinese oilfield system with mature development and new-resource research; this case examines compartment data and water handling. The course analyses total liquid in a high-water-cut scenario, net volume of distinct blocks, distinguishing oil output from recovery, treated-water reuse balance, alignment of datasets from different periods, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 高含水情境的總液量、不同區塊的有效體積、產油與回收概念區分
v31FocusEn: Total liquid in a high-water-cut scenario; Net volume of distinct blocks; Distinguishing oil output from recovery

quiz.question: 關於「高含水情境的總液量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Total liquid in a high-water-cut scenario" is correct?
options: 同一條集輸線內的總液量包含油與水；含水率升高時，即使售油量不變，分離、輸送與水處理負荷仍會增加。
油量維持不變，水處理設備就不會增加負荷。
地下含油體積就是最終能出售的原油量。
optionsEn: A gathering line carries both oil and water.
Constant oil output means unchanged water-treatment duty.
Oil volume in place is the final amount of saleable oil.

steps.instructionEn: The case interface is “Total liquid in a high-water-cut scenario”. Daqing is a major Chinese oilfield system with mature development and new-resource research; this case examines compartment data and water handling. In the teaching model for Daqing oil field, separate this interface from adjacent equipment before applying the following method. A gathering line carries both oil and water. As water cut rises, separation, transfer and water-treatment duty increase even if saleable oil output stays constant. Dividing oil flow by one minus water cut reconstructs total liquid flow, provided volume reference conditions match and dissolved-gas changes are neglected. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Qw = Qo fw/(1-fw)；代入 Qo = 1100 m³/day、fw = 0.35 fraction，得 592 m³/day（「高含水情境的總液量」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 fw 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.instructionEn: For “Total liquid in a high-water-cut scenario”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Recalculate water flow from oil and total-liquid meters over the same interval and check against an independent water-phase measurement after aligning timestamps and tank inventory changes. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Total liquid in a high-water-cut scenario” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。

Treating thin interbeds as continuous net pay systematically overestimates volume; inconsistent saturation sources can also create implausible volume jumps at compartment boundaries. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Daqing oil field”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把地質模型的平均值直接相乘，會忽略厚度與孔隙率的相關性；本模型只做分區體積帳，不把含油體積當成可採儲量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This model is a compartment volume account only and does not equate oil in place with recoverable reserves.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地下含油體積就是最終能出售的原油量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Oil volume in place is the final amount of saleable oil." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 「不同區塊的有效體積」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。若薄互層被當成整段有效層，體積會系統性高估；若水飽和度來源不同，分區邊界可能形成不合理的體積跳變。
knowledge.textEn: An error at “Net volume of distinct blocks” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Treating thin interbeds as continuous net pay systematically overestimates volume; inconsistent saturation sources can also create implausible volume jumps at compartment boundaries.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
